- Place your feet on their hips and extend your legs to push them back
- Pull their ankles toward you while pushing with your feet to sweep them backward
- Follow through by coming up on top into mount or side control

- From deep half guard, secure an underhook on their far leg with both arms
- Get your head to the outside of their leg and drive into them
- Lift their leg with your double underhook while driving forward with your shoulder
- Roll them over your shoulder as you come up to your knees
- Follow through to side control or mount as they fall to their back

- From butterfly guard, establish grips on their collar and sleeve
- Place your butterfly hook under their thigh on the side you want to sweep
- Fall to your back while pulling them forward with your grips
- Lift with your butterfly hook and extend your leg to elevate them
- Come up on top into mount or side control as they go over

- From closed guard, control their collar and sleeve on the same side
- Open your guard and place your foot on their hip on the controlled side
- Pull their sleeve across their body while pushing with your foot
- Swing your other leg over to help complete the sweep
- Follow through by coming up on top into side control or mount

- From half guard bottom, underhook their far leg and control their near ankle with your free hand
- Bridge up and turn toward their trapped leg while pulling their ankle toward you
- Use your underhook to lift their leg as you sweep them over your shoulder
- Follow through by coming up on top and establishing side control or mount

- From De La Riva guard, maintain your hook behind their knee and grip their collar or sleeve
- Step your free foot on their hip and push while pulling with your DLR hook
- Drive your knee across their body as they fall forward
- Follow through by coming up to your knees and establishing top position
- Finish in side control or continue to mount

- From X guard, secure both legs around their trapped leg with your feet hooking behind their knee and ankle
- Grip their belt or pants at the hip with both hands
- Lift with your legs while pulling them forward over your head
- Roll backward as they fall forward, maintaining control of their leg
- Come up on top and establish side control or knee on belly

- From open guard, grab both of their heels with your hands while keeping your feet on their hips
- Pull their heels toward you while pushing with your feet to off-balance them backward
- As they fall, maintain grip on their heels and follow through
- Come up quickly to establish top position before they can recover
- Transition to side control or mount

- From closed guard, sit up and wrap one arm around their back while posting your other hand on the mat
- Open your guard and place your foot on their hip on the same side as your posting hand
- Hip bump them by driving your hips up and forward while pushing with your foot
- As they post their hand back to catch themselves, sweep them over that side
- Follow through to mount or side control

- From octopus guard with your leg wrapped around their trapped arm
- Place your free hand on their hip or belt for leverage
- Explosively bump your hips up and forward while pulling with your octopus hook
- Drive them over your head using the hip momentum
- Follow through to land in top position or scramble for dominant position

- From half guard bottom, get an underhook on their far side and control their near wrist
- Bridge up and turn into them while pulling their controlled arm across your body
- Use your underhook to lift and roll them over your shoulder
- Drive through with your hips and legs to complete the sweep
- Come up on top in side control or mount position

- From half butterfly guard, secure a kimura grip on their near arm (figure-four grip)
- Hook their leg with your butterfly hook and get an underhook with your free arm
- Lift with your butterfly hook while pulling them forward with the kimura grip
- Roll them over your shoulder using the combined leverage of both grips
- Maintain the kimura grip as you come up on top for a submission or positional advantage

- From lasso guard, maintain your lasso around their arm and control their opposite sleeve
- Hook their near leg with your free leg behind their knee
- Pull with your lasso while lifting with your leg hook to off-balance them
- Drive your knee across their body as they fall to the side
- Follow through to establish side control or mount

- From half guard bottom, hug their trapped leg tightly with both arms
- Bridge up and turn toward their free leg while maintaining the leg hug
- Roll underneath them like an alligator death roll, keeping their leg trapped
- Use your momentum to sweep them over as you continue the rolling motion
- Come up on top in side control or mount position

- From closed guard, control their opposite collar and sleeve (cross grips)
- Open your guard and place your foot on their hip on the collar grip side
- Sit up and chop down with your collar hand while pulling their sleeve across
- Use your foot on their hip to help drive them over to the side
- Follow through to mount or side control position

- From half guard bottom, underhook their far arm and grip their wrist with your outside hand
- Post your outside foot on the mat and bridge up, rolling them over your shoulder
- Use your underhook to control their posture and prevent them from posting
- Drive through with your hips and legs to complete the sweep
- Maintain control of their arm as you come up to side control or mount

- From closed guard, control their right wrist and bring your left leg over their shoulder
- Thread your left leg under their armpit and sit up to secure the omoplata position
- Place your right hand on the mat behind you for base and lean forward
- Use your left leg to push their shoulder down while lifting your hips
- Roll them over your left shoulder to complete the sweep and come up on top

- From spider guard, maintain grips on both sleeves with feet in their biceps
- Release one foot from their bicep and place it on their hip
- Pull their opposite arm across their body while pushing with your hip foot
- Use your remaining spider guard foot to push their shoulder in the same direction
- Follow through by sitting up and coming on top as they fall to their side

- From octopus guard with your leg wrapped around their arm
- Hook your free leg behind their far ankle (kosoto hook)
- Pull their trapped arm toward you while pushing their head away
- Drive forward with your hips while sweeping their hooked leg
- Follow through to land in side control or scramble to top position

- From half guard bottom, get an underhook on their far side and control their near wrist
- Scoot your hips out and create an angle, placing your outside foot on their hip
- Swing your outside leg in a pendulum motion across their body
- Use the momentum to roll them over while maintaining your underhook
- Come up to side control or mount, keeping control of their arm

- From turtle position, reach under and grab their far leg with your outside arm
- Place your inside hand on the mat for base and drive your shoulder into their hip
- Roll backwards over your shoulder while pulling their leg with you
- Use your momentum to bring them over the top and land in their guard
- Maintain control of their leg throughout the roll to prevent them from escaping

- From reverse de la riva guard, maintain your hook behind their knee and grip their collar
- Insert your butterfly hook with your free leg between their legs
- Pull them forward with your collar grip while lifting with your butterfly hook
- Use your reverse de la riva hook to off-balance them backwards
- Elevate and sweep them over your head, following through to come on top

- From half guard bottom, secure an underhook on their near side instead of far side
- Grip their far wrist with your free hand and create space with your outside leg
- Bridge up and roll towards your underhook side, using their trapped leg as a pivot
- Drive through with your hips while pulling their arm across their body
- Complete the sweep by coming up to side control on their opposite side

- From closed guard, break their posture and control their right wrist with your left hand
- Place your right foot on their left hip and your left shin across their belt line
- Pull their right arm across their body while pushing their hip with your foot
- Scissor your legs by extending your hip foot and pulling with your shin
- Follow through by sitting up and establishing top position as they fall

- From closed guard, break their posture and control their left wrist with your right hand
- Place your left foot on their right hip and your right shin across their stomach
- Pull their controlled arm across their body while pushing their hip away
- Scissor your legs by extending your hip foot and pulling with your shin
- Sit up as they fall to establish mount or side control position

- From spider guard, maintain sleeve grips with both feet in their biceps
- Remove one foot from their bicep and hook it behind their same-side knee
- Pull their opposite sleeve while using your hook to sweep their leg
- Create a sickle motion by pulling their arm and sweeping their leg simultaneously
- Follow through by coming up on top as they fall to their side

- From closed guard, break their posture and control one sleeve while placing your other hand on their opposite ankle
- Open your guard and place your foot on their hip on the same side as the controlled ankle
- Pull their sleeve toward you while pushing their ankle away to off-balance them
- Sweep them over by continuing the ankle push while following through with your hip movement
- Come up on top and establish side control or mount

- From single leg X guard, secure an underhook on their trapped leg with your inside arm
- Hook their far leg with your top leg while maintaining the X-hook with your bottom leg
- Grip their ankle or pant leg with your free hand for additional control
- Drive forward with your underhook while lifting with your X-hook to sweep them backward
- Follow through to land in side control or half guard on top

- From shin on shin guard, control their sleeve on the same side as your top shin
- Grip their collar or lapel with your other hand for additional control
- Pull their sleeve across their body while pushing with your shin to create off-balance
- As they post their hand to defend, switch your grip to their wrist and continue pulling
- Sweep them over to the side while coming up to establish top position

- From lasso guard, maintain the lasso hook while controlling their opposite sleeve
- Place your free foot on their hip or thigh on the lasso side
- Pull their sleeve toward you while pushing with your hip foot to create diagonal pressure
- Use your lasso hook to lift and sweep them over your head
- Follow the sweep by coming up on top and securing side control

- From shin on shin guard, control both their sleeves or collar and sleeve
- Keep your shin pressure against their shin while maintaining good posture
- Pull them forward over your shin while lifting your hips up
- As they fall forward, guide them straight over your head with your grips
- Roll backward and come up on top in their guard or side control

- From turtle position when opponent is behind you, grab their ankle on one side
- Sit back toward their trapped leg while maintaining the ankle grip
- Use your free hand to post on the mat for base as you change direction
- Pull their ankle while driving your shoulder into their leg to sweep them
- Come up on top and establish side control or back control

- From spider guard, maintain both sleeve grips with feet in their biceps
- Remove one foot from their bicep and place it high on their chest or shoulder
- Keep the other foot pushing their bicep while pulling both sleeves
- Scissor your legs by bringing the high foot down while lifting with the low foot
- Sweep them over and follow through to mount or side control

- From deep half guard, secure an underhook on their far leg with your bottom arm
- Get your outside hand to the mat and begin to technical stand up
- Keep your head tight to their hip while maintaining the underhook
- Drive forward with your legs while lifting with the underhook to sweep them backward
- Complete the sweep and establish side control or knee on belly

- From open guard, control their same-side sleeve and place your foot on their hip
- Grip their ankle on the opposite side with your free hand
- Pull their sleeve while pushing their hip with your foot to create rotation
- As they turn, use your ankle grip to guide them into the sweep
- Follow through by coming up on top and securing side control

- From open guard, place one foot on their hip and the other foot on their knee on the same side
- Control their opposite sleeve with both hands or sleeve and collar
- Push their hip away with your foot while pulling their knee toward you with your other foot
- Pull their sleeve to complete the off-balance and sweep them over
- Come up on top and establish side control or mount

- From De La Riva guard, establish DLR hook on their far leg and grip their same-side collar
- Place your outside foot on their near hip as a tripod base
- Pull their collar toward you while extending your tripod leg to off-balance them
- As they fall backward, follow through by coming up on top and securing side control

- From Reverse De La Riva guard, hook their near leg with your outside leg and grip their collar
- Place your inside foot on their far hip to create the tripod structure
- Pull their collar while pushing with your tripod foot to break their base
- Drive forward as they fall to secure top position and advance to side control

- From deep half guard, secure an underhook on their far arm and grip their wrist
- Place your outside foot flat on the mat for base and drive your knee into their hip
- Lift their arm overhead like a waiter carrying a tray while bridging into them
- Roll them over your body toward the underhook side
- Come up on top and establish side control or mount

- From closed guard, break their posture and secure a deep overhook on one arm
- Grip their wrist with your opposite hand and lift their arm overhead
- Open your guard and place your same-side foot on their hip for leverage
- Bridge and roll toward the overhook side while maintaining wrist control
- Follow through to mount or side control as they roll over

- From octopus guard with your leg wrapped around their arm
- Post your free hand on the mat behind you for base
- Use your octopus hook to pull yourself up while driving your hips forward
- Get your feet under you and establish an underhook with your free arm
- Drive through their base to complete the takedown or secure dominant position

- From standing wrestling position, create an angle by stepping to the outside of their lead leg
- Drop your level and reach for their ankle with both hands
- Grab their ankle firmly and drive your shoulder into their thigh
- Lift their ankle while driving forward to take them down
- Follow through to secure top position on the ground

- From standing position, grip their wrist and elbow on one side
- Pull their arm across their body while stepping behind them
- Duck under their arm and emerge behind them with back control
- Drive them forward while maintaining your grips
- Take them down by driving forward or tripping their legs

- From standing, secure a body lock by wrapping both arms around their torso
- Lock your hands together behind their back in a bear hug grip
- Lift them slightly off the ground by arching your back and squeezing
- Drive them backward or to the side while maintaining the body lock
- Follow them to the ground and establish top control

- From standing judo grip, control their sleeve and lapel with proper hand placement
- Step forward with your lead foot and sweep their advancing foot with your rear foot
- Time the sweep as they step forward, catching their foot as it touches the ground
- Pull with your hands while sweeping to break their balance forward
- Follow through with your body movement to complete the throw

- From standing position, change levels by dropping into a low squat stance
- Drive forward and wrap both arms around both of their legs at thigh level
- Keep your head to the side of their hip to avoid guillotines
- Lift and drive through them while stepping your feet closer
- Take them down and establish side control or advance position

- From standing wrestling position, create hand fighting to set up the entry
- Duck under their extended arm by dropping your level and stepping across
- Emerge behind them with your arm around their waist
- Drive them forward while maintaining back control
- Trip their legs or drive them down to secure the takedown

- From standing wrestling position, duck under their arm and step deep between their legs
- Drive your shoulder into their midsection while wrapping your arm around their far leg
- Grab their near arm with your free hand and pull it across your shoulders
- Stand up explosively, lifting them onto your shoulders
- Step forward and dump them to the mat by releasing their leg and driving forward

- From standing wrestling position, create an opening by pushing or pulling your opponent
- As they react, quickly step around to their back side
- Wrap your arms around their waist from behind
- Keep your head to one side to avoid their defensive elbows
- Drive forward and down to take them to the mat, maintaining back control

- From standing judo grip (sleeve and lapel), step in close with your right foot near their right foot
- Turn your hips and sweep your right leg across the back of both their legs
- Simultaneously pull with your left hand and push/lift with your right hand
- Keep your sweeping leg straight and drive through their legs
- Follow through by driving them backward over your sweeping leg

- From standing wrestling position, change levels by dropping your hips and stepping in
- Drive your shoulder into their hip while shooting your arms between their legs
- Grab high on their far leg (crotch area) with both hands
- Keep your head up and drive forward while lifting their leg
- Trip their standing leg or continue driving to complete the takedown

- From standing judo grip, pull your opponent forward to get them stepping
- As they step forward with their right foot, place your right foot against their right knee
- Pull strongly with your left hand while pushing their upper body with your right
- Use your foot as a fulcrum to wheel them over your blocking leg
- Time the technique as their weight commits to the blocked leg

- From standing wrestling position, control their head and arm with collar ties
- Step your inside foot between their feet, close to their inside leg
- Hook your inside foot behind their inside leg at the ankle
- Pull their upper body toward you while lifting and tripping their leg
- Drive through to complete the takedown, maintaining upper body control

- From standing judo grip, step in deep with your right foot in front of both their feet
- Duck under their right arm and load them onto your back by bending at the waist
- Grip their right arm with both hands, pulling it across your chest
- Straighten your legs explosively while pulling their arm down
- Throw them over your shoulder by continuing the forward and downward motion

- From standing wrestling position, change levels and step in close to your opponent
- Reach down and grab behind their near knee with your outside hand
- Control their head or shoulder with your other hand
- Pull their knee up toward their chest while pushing their upper body backward
- Drive through to complete the takedown as they lose balance

- From standing judo grip, step in close and turn your back to your opponent
- Wrap your right arm around their neck/head area from the side
- Place your hip against their hip and bend your knees slightly
- Lift them onto your hip while pulling with your arms
- Rotate and throw them over your hip to the mat

- From standing judo grip, step forward with your left foot outside their right foot
- Hook your left foot around the back of their right ankle
- Pull them forward and slightly to their right with your grips
- Reap their right leg backward with your left foot while maintaining forward pressure
- Follow through by driving them backward over their trapped leg

- From standing judo grip (lapel and sleeve), step close to your opponent
- Use your inside leg to hook behind their near ankle while pulling with your grips
- Apply forward pressure with your upper body while reaping their leg backward
- Drive them forward and down as their supporting leg is compromised
- Follow through by stepping past them as they fall

- From standing judo grip, step deep with your right foot between their legs
- Turn your hips and place your right hip against their lower abdomen
- Wrap your right arm around their waist while maintaining lapel grip
- Lift with your hips and legs while pulling them over your hip
- Rotate and throw them over your hip to the mat

- From standing judo grip, step outside their right leg with your right foot
- Drive your right leg behind their right leg while pulling with your grips
- Push their upper body backward while sweeping their leg forward
- Use your chest and shoulder to drive them backward over your reaping leg
- Follow through until they hit the mat on their back

- From standing judo grip, step between their legs with your right foot
- Hook your right leg behind their left leg from the inside
- Pull them forward with your grips while driving your shoulder into their chest
- Reap their leg backward while pushing their upper body forward
- Drive through until they fall forward over your reaping leg

- From standing wrestling position, secure an underhook or collar tie
- Step your outside leg behind their near leg while maintaining upper body control
- Use your leg to trip their ankle while pulling them in that direction
- Drive your weight through them as they lose balance over the trip
- Follow them to the ground maintaining top position

- From standing judo grip, step forward and place your right foot against their left ankle
- Pull them forward with your grips while blocking their ankle with your foot
- Use your foot as a prop to prevent their forward step
- Lift and pull them over your blocking foot while they're off-balance
- Continue the circular motion until they fall forward

- From standing position, change levels by dropping your hips and stepping in
- Shoot your arms around their thigh, clasping your hands behind their leg
- Drive your shoulder into their thigh while lifting the leg
- Step to the outside and drive them backward or to the side
- Take them down while maintaining control of the leg for top position

- From standing wrestling position, secure a collar tie or head control
- Pull their head down sharply while stepping back
- Use your other hand to push down on their shoulder or back
- As they react by posting their hands down, circle around to their back
- Secure back control or look for other takedown opportunities

- From standing judo grip, step across with your right foot in front of their legs
- Turn your body perpendicular to theirs while maintaining grips
- Use your right leg as a blocking post while pulling them forward
- Rotate your body and pull them over your extended leg
- Drive the throw through with your arms while they fall over your leg

- From standing judo grip, step in close and sit down between their legs
- Place your foot on their hip or lower abdomen as you fall backward
- Pull them forward with your grips while extending your leg
- Use your foot to launch them over your head in a circular motion
- Roll backward and throw them over you using the momentum

- From standing position, establish a strong collar and sleeve grip on your opponent
- Step in close with your support leg while pulling them forward and off-balance
- Swing your throwing leg high between their legs, making contact with your inner thigh against their inner thigh
- Drive your leg upward and backward while pulling down with your grips
- Follow through by lifting them over your leg and driving them to the mat
